# 类别不平衡：相关章节综合实践
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);X=rng.normal(size=(100,4));y=(X[:,0]>0).astype(int)
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=60,min_samples_leaf=3).fit(X[:70],y[:70])
print("Validation accuracy:",m.score(X[70:],y[70:]))

# 非线性因子组合：相关章节综合实践
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);X=rng.normal(size=(120,4));y=X[:,0]+.5*X[:,1]+rng.normal(size=120)
m=RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=40,random_state=0).fit(X[:80],y[:80])
print("Holdout error:",np.mean((m.predict(X[80:])-y[80:])**2))
